Package org.jlab.coda.emu.modules

Class ModuleAdapter

java.lang.Object
org.jlab.coda.emu.modules.ModuleAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
EmuModule, CODAStateMachine, StatedObject
Direct Known Subclasses:
Dummy, EventRecording, FarmController, FastEventBuilder, RocFixedRateSimulation, RocSimulation, StreamAggregator, StreamAggregatorOrig, TsFixedRateSimulation, TsSimulation
public class ModuleAdapter extends Object implements EmuModule
This class contains boilerplate code for implementing a module.

    • representsEmuStatistics

      public boolean representsEmuStatistics()
      If an EMU has more than one module, which module's statistics represent the EMU as a whole needs to be determined. This method returns true if this module's statistics may represent the EMU as a whole. This may be specified in an EMU's xml configuration file by including the attribute statistics="on" in the module definition.
      Specified by:
      representsEmuStatistics in interface EmuModule
      Returns:
      true if this module's statistics represents the EMU, else false.

    • getStatistics

      public Object[] getStatistics()

      Get the output statistics of this EmuModule object. The output statistics consists of an array of 2 Longs, 2 Floats, 4 Integers, 1 int array, and one Long:

      1. event count (Long)
      2. word count (Long)
      3. event rate in Hz (Float)
      4. data rate in kBytes/sec (Float)
      5. max event size in bytes (Integer) if module is an EB
      6. min event size in bytes (Integer) if module is an EB
      7. avg event size in bytes (Integer) if module is an EB
      8. suggested value for chunk*EtBufSize (Integer) if have ET output channel
      9. if EB and switched on, histogram of time to build 1 event in nanoseconds (int array)
      10. frame count if aggregating streamed data, else null (Long)
      11. frame rate if aggregating streamed data, else null (Float)
      Specified by:
      getStatistics in interface EmuModule
      Returns:
      array of objects containing in order: 1) event count (Long), 2) word count (Long), 3) event rate(Float), 4) data rate (Float), 5) max event byte size (Integer), 6) min event byte size (Integer), 7) average event byte size (Integer), 8) suggested value for chunk*EtBufSize (Integer) if have ET output channel, 9) histogram of time to build 1 event in nanosec (int array), null if no statistics reported for this module, 10) frame count if aggregating streamed data (Long), 11) frame rate if aggregating streamed data (Float)

    • adjustStatistics

      public void adjustStatistics(long eventsAdded, long wordsAdded)
      Adjust the event count and word count reported by this module to run control by added the given numbers. This is necessary in the file output channel when the limit of the disk partition is reached and physics events must be thrown away after passing through the module.
      Specified by:
      adjustStatistics in interface EmuModule
      Parameters:
      eventsAdded - number of events to be added the event count
      wordsAdded - number of words to be added the word count

    • setSingleVTPInputs

      public void setSingleVTPInputs(boolean singleVTPInputs)
      Method to set whether this module has only a single VTP for an input channel. The EMU prestart method calls this to set singleVTPInputs based on its parsing of config file. Called to notify the module that inputs can be combined into a single ROC Time Slice Bank.
      Parameters:
      singleVTPInputs - true if this module has only a single VTP for an input channel, else false.
